## Our story · our-story · story

### A painted-fashion point of view

TCPF stands for Tisha Chavez Painted Fashion. Based in Naga City, the boutique brings original paintings and artworks into modern Filipiniana clothing.

The starting point is an expressive image: color, brushwork, and a story carried into a garment. Ready-to-wear pieces invite customers to explore that relationship through familiar silhouettes and matching separates. Bespoke inquiries offer another conversation around a personal idea or occasion.

This website demonstration uses original AI-generated concepts. The samples illustrate the proposed shopping experience; final artwork attribution and real garment details require client approval.

## Bespoke · bespoke · bespoke

### Bring an idea to the conversation

Tell TCPF about the garment, occasion, or artwork direction you have in mind. An inquiry does not confirm an order, a price, or a production date.

Proposed inquiry path, for client confirmation before launch:

1. Share your idea, garment interest, and any occasion date.
2. Discuss the possibilities, measurements, artwork direction, and practical requirements.
3. Confirm the design, quotation, and agreed timeline before proceeding.

The client must confirm the actual operating process and terms. No turnaround or price is promised in the demonstration.

## Size guide · size-guide · size-guide

Sample charts and fit notes are demonstration values, not verified stock specifications. Actual measurements must be checked on physical garments before products are made available to buy.
